ideas.title: Investigation into Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti, including the actions of federal agents and potential policy violations.
ideas.angle: Examining the use of force and potential misconduct by law enforcement
questions: Were federal agents justified in using force?
What was the response of local authorities?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential patterns of misconduct or excessive force by federal agents, and shed light on the need for greater accountability and transparency in law enforcement actions.

ideas.title: Trump Administration's Handling of Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's response to the Minneapolis shooting, including any potential politicization of the incident.
ideas.angle: Examining the administration's actions and potential motivations
questions: Were there any attempts to politicize the incident?
What was the impact on community relations?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential patterns of politicization or mishandling of the incident by the Trump administration, and shed light on the consequences for community trust and relations.
